public_contracts.name: generate
public_contracts.summary: Build a known synthetic process; no empirical market estimates are used.

public_contracts.name: dependency_components
public_contracts.summary: Whole blocks are units; cross-boundary footprints/links can only merge.

public_contracts.name: permutations
public_contracts.summary: One mapping shared by every symbol, target copy and tested feature.

public_contracts.name: transformed_targets
public_contracts.summary: Expose the actual tensor transformation for integrity/chain tests.

public_contracts.name: pit_regime
public_contracts.summary: Validate a retained registration receipt, never reconstruct a past label.

public_contracts.name: independence_groups
public_contracts.summary: Merge global dependencies; never split pre-existing groups.

public_contracts.name: complete_actual
public_contracts.summary: Only the canonical replay contract can certify an execution outcome.

public_contracts.name: eligible_actuals
public_contracts.summary: Join only PIT execution episodes, deduplicate trade identity, enforce cut.

public_contracts.name: compensated_sum_columns
public_contracts.summary: Column-wise replica of CPython 3.12 ``sum(list_of_floats)`` (int start 0, Neumaier compensation).

public_contracts.name: reference_rows
public_contracts.summary: Row list and lookup exactly as the Scheme D harness (``_arranged_rows``) builds them.

public_contracts.name: reference_statistics
public_contracts.summary: Reference: production ``_metric`` per hypothesis.  Returns a list of signed effects (None = untestable).

public_contracts.name: FastMetric
public_contracts.summary: Per-world encoder; ``statistics(block_map)`` returns ``(signed, ok)`` for all hypotheses.

public_contracts.name: ProtocolError
public_contracts.summary: The frozen input or protocol contract was violated.

public_contracts.name: load_locked_artifact
public_contracts.summary: Load only the approved artifact, without touching any other source.

public_contracts.name: allowed_atom
public_contracts.summary: Return whether an atom is exactly in the frozen allow-list.

public_contracts.name: canonical_pattern
public_contracts.summary: Canonicalize and validate a state/transition/sequence pattern.

public_contracts.name: numeric_bins
public_contracts.summary: Compute frozen global p33/p67 bins; missing/non-finite values are ignored.

public_contracts.name: IntegrityError
public_contracts.summary: A deterministic validation or benchmark-isolation check failed.

public_contracts.name: WorldRefused
public_contracts.summary: Synthetic metadata failed before permutation RNG construction.

public_contracts.name: SeedRegistry
public_contracts.summary: Fail closed: the pre-RNG module cannot construct any generator.

public_contracts.name: verify_frozen_environment
public_contracts.summary: Verify protocol hashes and exact runtime metadata before any RNG.

public_contracts.name: generate_world
public_contracts.summary: Refuse world generation while this module remains pre-RNG.

public_contracts.name: draw_block_map
public_contracts.summary: Draw one synchronized whole-block map; repeated calls are with replacement.

public_contracts.name: actual_statistic_vector
public_contracts.summary: Evaluate all 384 hypotheses through the imported production ``_metric``.

public_contracts.name: apply_injections
public_contracts.summary: Refuse injected-world generation while this module remains pre-RNG.

public_contracts.name: generate_truth_tables
public_contracts.summary: Generate all 55 pre-RNG 384-row tables, refusing no ambiguity silently.

public_contracts.name: derive_n1_null_mad
public_contracts.summary: Deterministic Gauss-Legendre derivation for t3/sqrt(3) plus common jump.

public_contracts.name: applicable_label_families
public_contracts.summary: Return every registered label family for one canonical pattern.

module_responsibilities.summary: Pure synthetic laboratory for the UNFROZEN 28-day M3.2 block proposal.
Pure, fail-closed M3.2 evidence validation; no collection or search authority.
Exact-equivalent optimized M3.2 ``_metric`` for whole-block-permutation validation worlds.
Deterministic, read-only validation primitives for the M3.2 slice.
Synthetic-only Scheme D actual-statistic validation primitives.
Bounded deterministic M3.2 historical pattern search.
